reason: A DSH bundle for managing an Obsidian-compatible Markdown knowledge vault, with agent skills, indexing and maintenance scripts, templates, scheduled reminders, and a documented review-and-promotion workflow.

summaries.zh: 用于通过 DSH 和 Obsidian 管理 Markdown 个人知识库，提供笔记导入、维护、索引、模板及定期巡检工作流。
summaries.en: A DSH and Obsidian bundle for managing a Markdown personal knowledge base with note ingestion, maintenance, indexing, templates, and scheduled review workflows.

capabilities: Initializes and maintains a Markdown knowledge vault
Provides agent skills for ingesting, writing, maintaining, and summarizing notes
Supports scheduled weekly reminders for inspections and reports
Writes drafts and metadata within designated vault areas and can create git commits according to the documented workflow
